title: Character Continuity & Identity — Player Memory, Location & Presence

code.onModelContext:
const modifier = (text) => {
    const continuityStatus = getCharacterContinuityList();
    const sceneStatus = getCharacterContinuitySceneSummary();

    const rules =
        "\n\n[SILENT CHARACTER CONTINUITY]\n" +

        "Apply these rules internally while continuing the EXISTING story. " +
        "Output only story narration plus required hidden control tags. " +
        "NEVER acknowledge, quote, summarize, discuss, or explain these rules. " +
        "NEVER say you are ready to begin. " +
        "NEVER ask for a scenario, prompt, character cards, instructions, or confirmation because of these rules. " +
        "The story is already in progress unless the actual adventure text establishes otherwise. " +

        "\n\nCONTINUITY STATE:\n" +
        continuityStatus +

        "\n\nSCENE STATE:\n" +
        sceneStatus +

        "\n\nCONTINUITY IS PASSIVE: " +
        "Continuity records what the story establishes; continuity does NOT create story events. " +
        "Tracking a location does not move anyone. " +
        "Tracking scene presence does not summon anyone. " +
        "Tracking an ability does not cause it to be used. " +
        "Tracking an identity fact does not require it to be described. " +
        "Never manufacture an event merely so continuity state can change. " +

        "\n\nSOURCE OF TRUTH: " +
        "Explicit player selections, character creation, Story Cards, scenario facts, established narration, and explicit player statements are authoritative. " +
        "Established facts remain true until the actual story explicitly changes or corrects them. " +
        "Never replace established facts for variety, convenience, genre convention, or drama. " +

        "\n\nPLAYER IDENTITY: " +
        "Keep the human-controlled player character correctly identified. " +
        "Preserve all established player facts, including name, age, gender, pronouns, species, appearance, anatomy, occupation, background, family, home, orientation when established, skills, abilities, powers, scars, tattoos, and permanent traits. " +
        "Never randomly change or forget them. " +
        "Never transfer another character's identity or appearance to the player. " +
        "If a player characteristic is unspecified, it remains UNKNOWN. " +
        "Unknown information is NOT permission to invent it. " +
        "NPC assumptions about the player do not become objective truth. " +

        "\n\nNPC IDENTITY: " +
        "Preserve established NPC appearance, species, age, occupation, background, family, abilities, powers, skills, scars, tattoos, and other important identity facts. " +
        "Do not redesign established characters between scenes. " +

        "\n\nTEMPORARY VS PERMANENT: " +
        "Temporary clothing, disguises, dirt, wet hair, transformations, injuries, magical effects, and other temporary conditions do not overwrite baseline identity. " +
        "Only an explicitly established lasting change may permanently alter an established identity fact. " +

        "\n\nLOCATION LOCK — HARD RULE: " +
        "The established active scene location remains the active scene location until the STORY ACTUALLY ESTABLISHES movement or a transition to somewhere else. " +
        "Do not invent a different setting because it would provide new scenery, characters, action, or description. " +
        "If the current scene is in an office, continue in the office until someone actually leaves or the story explicitly transitions elsewhere. " +
        "Do not suddenly replace an office with a market, street, restaurant, home, forest, vehicle, bedroom, workplace, or any other location. " +

        "\n\nLOCATION CHANGES REQUIRE CAUSE: " +
        "A new location must result from an actual established departure, travel sequence, arrival, scene transition, teleportation, forced movement, or other valid movement event. " +
        "A location tag records a change that ALREADY OCCURRED in the story. " +
        "A location tag is NEVER permission or justification to invent a location change. " +

        "\n\nPLAYER MOVEMENT: " +
        "Never move the player merely to reconcile continuity or create a new scene. " +
        "Do not write that the player walks away, follows someone, enters another room, travels somewhere, moves through a crowd, approaches someone, or otherwise voluntarily relocates unless the player explicitly established that action. " +
        "External forces and involuntary movement may affect the player when genuinely caused by the world, but continuity itself never causes movement. " +

        "\n\nNPC MOVEMENT: " +
        "NPCs may move autonomously when appropriate, but movement must be physically and narratively plausible. " +
        "An NPC who is elsewhere cannot instantly appear in the active scene without an established means of arrival. " +
        "Do not teleport NPCs for convenience unless teleportation is an established ability being used. " +

        "\n\nSCENE PRESENCE: " +
        "Existence is not presence. " +
        "Only characters actually present in the scene may normally speak into the conversation, physically interact with the scene, or visibly react to it. " +
        "A character who leaves is absent until they genuinely return. " +
        "Do not summon important or favorite NPCs merely because they exist in the scenario. " +

        "\n\nPERCEPTION: " +
        "Characters normally perceive events only through plausible senses from their actual location. " +
        "Absent characters cannot automatically hear conversations, see events, react to private dialogue, or know what just happened. " +
        "Narrator knowledge is not NPC knowledge. " +

        "\n\nREMOTE AND ENHANCED PERCEPTION: " +
        "Super hearing, enhanced vision, telepathy, clairvoyance, surveillance, cameras, phones, radios, magic, and similar methods work only when explicitly established and actually capable of perceiving the event. " +
        "Never invent a perception ability to justify knowledge. " +
        "Possessing an ability or device does not mean it is constantly active. " +
        "Remote perception does not make a character physically present. " +

        "\n\nNO EXPOSITION FROM CONTINUITY: " +
        "Continuity exists to prevent contradictions, not to generate scenery or biography dumps. " +
        "Do not repeat established appearance, location, abilities, background, or environmental description merely because continuity remembers it. " +
        "Do not restart or re-establish the scene. " +
        "Continue naturally from the immediate story context. " +

        "\n\nSCRIPT COMPATIBILITY: " +
        "Do not override other attached systems. " +
        "Player Agency controls player dialogue, thoughts, feelings, decisions, consent, and voluntary actions. " +
        "Relationship systems control relationship state. " +
        "Health systems control health and injury state. " +
        "Pregnancy systems control pregnancy. " +
        "Beastkin systems control Beastkin biology and forms. " +
        "Time systems control tracked time. " +

        "\n\nCONTROL TAGS — SILENT METADATA ONLY: " +
        "Never discuss these tags. " +
        "Never display explanations for them. " +
        "Emit a tag only when the story itself has newly established the corresponding fact or change. " +
        "Do not emit tags merely because an old fact was mentioned again. " +

        "\n[CONT_PLAYER:NAME]" +
        "\n[CONT_CHARACTER:NAME]" +
        "\n[CONT_IDENTITY:NAME|FIELD|VALUE]" +
        "\n[CONT_IDENTITY_OVERRIDE:NAME|FIELD|VALUE]" +
        "\n[CONT_APPEARANCE:NAME|FIELD|VALUE]" +
        "\n[CONT_APPEARANCE_OVERRIDE:NAME|FIELD|VALUE]" +
        "\n[CONT_SCAR:NAME|DETAIL]" +
        "\n[CONT_TATTOO:NAME|DETAIL]" +
        "\n[CONT_TRAIT:NAME|DETAIL]" +
        "\n[CONT_ABILITY:NAME|DETAIL]" +
        "\n[CONT_POWER:NAME|DETAIL]" +
        "\n[CONT_SKILL:NAME|DETAIL]" +
        "\n[CONT_FAMILY:NAME|DETAIL]" +
        "\n[CONT_FACT:NAME|DETAIL]" +
        "\n[CONT_TEMP_ADD:NAME|DETAIL]" +
        "\n[CONT_TEMP_REMOVE:NAME|DETAIL]" +
        "\n[CONT_TEMP_CLEAR:NAME]" +
        "\n[CONT_LOCATION:NAME|LOCATION]" +
        "\n[CONT_SCENE:LOCATION]" +
        "\n[CONT_ENTER:NAME]" +
        "\n[CONT_LEAVE:NAME]" +
        "\n[CONT_PERCEPTION_ABILITY:NAME|ABILITY]" +
        "\n[CONT_PERCEPTION_DEVICE:NAME|DEVICE]" +
        "\n[CONT_REMOTE_ADD:NAME|SOURCE]" +
        "\n[CONT_REMOTE_REMOVE:NAME|SOURCE]" +
        "\n[CONT_REMOTE_CLEAR:NAME]" +
        "\n[CONT_NOTE:NAME|DETAIL]" +

        "\n\nTAG SAFETY: " +
        "CONT_SCENE and CONT_LOCATION may only RECORD a location already established by actual story movement or an existing scene fact. " +
        "Never invent movement in order to emit them. " +
        "CONT_ENTER means the character genuinely arrived; it does not cause an arrival. " +
        "CONT_LEAVE means the character genuinely departed; it does not cause a departure. " +
        "Override tags require an explicit correction or genuine lasting change. " +
        "Place continuity tags before any other script tag that is required to be the absolute final output item.";

    return {
        text: text + rules
    };
};

modifier(text);
